messages:
maria: Anyone seeing a flood of pages from pagerbridge? Just got paged twice in 30s for the same error :confused:
incidentbot: auto-suppress engaged: 17 duplicate pages suppressed for routing key 'prod/pagerbridge' (window=60s) :warning:
devon: +1. Logs show repeated webhook retries with 429s from the paging upstream. attaching short log sample:
```
2026-03-17T09:02:12Z pagerbridge incoming webhook id=abc123 status=429 retry=1
2026-03-17T09:02:13Z pagerbridge dispatch to incidentflow failed status=400 payload.tagging=\"\"
2026-03-17T09:02:14Z pagerbridge incoming webhook id=abc124 status=429 retry=1
```
luke: looks like incidentflow expects a 'severity' or 'customer_tag' field and pagerbridge is dropping tags when header size > 8k. routing rule matcher falls back and triggers manual pages.
emily: confirmed - I see header-truncation logs in the gateway: `request.headers: truncated at 8192 bytes`
maria: customer impact check: paging flood created duplicate on-call noise. From alerts we saw 3 customer-facing services show elevated error rates for ~12m. I see 5 active customer incidents in Zendesk that reference "delivery error".
sre-oncall: I will take this for live mitigation. plan: 1) temporarily disable strict tag-matching in incidentflow to stop manual pages 2) re-route paging to backup relay 3) open incident ticket for root cause. Handoff to me now.
emily: temporary workaround applied: ran `shopsctl set incidentflow.matching.strict=false --env=prod` — immediate effect: suppressed manual escalation. pages dropped to normal within 30s.
incidentbot: automation note: incidentflow rule override by emily applied by ops-admin (audit id=ops-20260317-01)
maria: thanks. EMILY can you post the exact CLI command for the post-incident notes?
emily: sure: `shopsctl set incidentflow.matching.strict=false --env=prod && shopsctl route set pagerbridge backup-relay --env=prod`
devon: will create a short customer-facing summary: "We experienced a transient paging storm due to header truncation causing missing routing tags; mitigation applied and pages are back to normal. Investigating permanent fix."
sre-oncall: assigning follow-ups: [INC-2026-042] create postmortem, [ENG-2345] fix header truncation in gateway, [OPS-678] add canary test to ensure tagging preserved for large payloads. I'll own incidence timeline for 2h and hand off to next oncall at 11:30 UTC.
pagerbot: note: 9 pages acknowledged automatically during suppression window; 0 missed manual escalations reported.
maria: ack. tagging mismatch + gateway header limit seems plausible root cause. Who can test a patch to increase header buffer?
luke: I can prototype a patch, will test in staging and post results here by EOD.
emily: adding short mitigation note to the incident ticket and tagging affected customers for follow-up.
devon: @sre-oncall any ETA on the postmortem doc?
sre-oncall: I'll start the timeline now and aim to publish a preliminary postmortem within 72h. For now, watching for any customer noise. If anyone sees a re-occurence ping me immediately. :point_up:
maria: thanks team. closing this thread once ops confirms no regressions after the next oncall rotation. :white_check_mark:
